name: Maido Mánie
source: Itoshi's sister needs money yet again. And since Itoshi is so feminine, what could be better than signing him up for some work in the nearby café - as a maid. Visual novel about traps, love and cakes with tea made for Animefest 2010 Contest.
translation: 伊俊的姐姐又一次需要用钱。既然伊俊长得如此女性化，还有什么工作会比在附近咖啡馆当女仆更适合他呢？这是一部为Animefest 2010大赛制作的视觉小说，讲述男扮女装者、爱情、蛋糕与红茶。
